nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: You have five minutes. Go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have five minutes. Go.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Confidential. And you've lost a minute based on the stupidity of that question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Confidential. And you've lost a minute based on the stupidity of that question.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Now you're down to three.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now you're down to three.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: How do you know of the Happy Hour Friends?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you know of the Happy Hour Friends?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: The HHF were a nihilistic group HOVA-bent on opening time rifts across the city. They pitched their idea, got funding from a Corpster, and then you know what they did?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The HHF were a nihilistic group HOVA-bent on opening time rifts across the city. They pitched their idea, got funding from a Corpster, and then you know what they did?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: They drove a tram through a wall and into the ocean. Do you understand the kind of paperwork an incident like that comes with? I missed my daughter's graduation because of those assholes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They drove a tram through a wall and into the ocean. Do you understand the kind of paperwork an incident like that comes with? I missed my daughter's graduation because of those assholes.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Of course they didn't discover time travel. They were a group of misfits on their twelfth beers attempting to do complex math. What do you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course they didn't discover time travel. They were a group of misfits on their twelfth beers attempting to do complex math. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: In fact it was. Now, if we're done here, you've more than used up your allotted five minutes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In fact it was. Now, if we're done here, you've more than used up your allotted five minutes.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Need I remind you that my job involves arresting individuals?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Need I remind you that my job involves arresting individuals?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: No. And why would they? This timeline has exponentially worked in their favor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. And why would they? This timeline has exponentially worked in their favor.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Believe me, the pleasure is far from mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Believe me, the pleasure is far from mine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Player

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you recall anything about the Happy Hour Friends?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's ridiculous!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I'm looking for information about the Happy Hour Friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, okay! I'm looking for information about the Happy Hour Friends.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Okay, okay! I'm looking for information about the Happy Hour Friends.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Okay, okay! I'm looking for information about the Happy Hour Friends.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you acting like that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you acting like that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you acting like that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you acting like that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Someone told me about them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone told me about them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm looking for information on time travel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm looking for information on time travel.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm looking for information on time travel.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm looking for information on time travel.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They sound harmless?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They sound harmless?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bummer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bummer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So they didn't actually discover time travel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So they didn't actually discover time travel?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So they didn't actually discover time travel?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So they didn't actually discover time travel?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're mad because they made you do your job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're mad because they made you do your job?

nodes.text: Has 'Sec or any of the corps been working on time travel?
